rows.ja: 競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: ゴールドマンとともに工場建設向けに10億ドル以上の融資を確約
relations.text_en: Committed, with Goldman Sachs, at least $1 billion of secured financing for facility construction

source.label: MP Materials 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: we also obtained a commitment letter (the "Commitment Letter") from JPMorgan Chase Funding Inc. and Goldman Sachs Bank USA (along with their affiliates, the "Banks"), pursuant to which the Banks agreed to provide committed secured financing in an amount equal to, in the aggregate, at least $1 billion.

companies.name: ゴールドマン・サックス

relations.text: JPモルガンとともに10億ドル以上の融資を確約
relations.text_en: Committed, with JPMorgan, at least $1 billion of secured financing

source.label: MP Materials 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: we also obtained a commitment letter (the "Commitment Letter") from JPMorgan Chase Funding Inc. and Goldman Sachs Bank USA (along with their affiliates, the "Banks"), pursuant to which the Banks agreed to provide committed secured financing in an amount equal to, in the aggregate, at least $1 billion.

relations.text: 官民提携で磁石工場の建設を支え、価格下限保証と全量買取権を持つ
relations.text_en: Public-private partnership with a price floor and the right to buy all magnets from the 10X Facility

source.label: MP Materials 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On July 9, 2025, the Company entered into definitive agreements with the United States Department of War (the "DoW"), formerly known as the Department of Defense, (collectively, the "DoW Transaction Agreements") establishing a transformational public-private partnership with the DoW to accelerate the build-out of an end-to-end U.S. rare earth magnet supply chain and reduce foreign dependency (the "DoW Transactions").

relations.text: サウジでレアアース精製の合弁を計画(MPと国防総省で49%)
relations.text_en: Plans a rare earth refinery joint venture in Saudi Arabia, with MP and the DoW targeting 49%

source.label: MP Materials 発表(2025年11月19日)
source.quote: Under the agreement, MP Materials and the DoW (through a joint venture) will hold an equity position targeted at 49% in the joint venture, with Maaden holding a position of no less than 51%.

relations.text: 磁石の長期供給契約と、リサイクル設備の導入
relations.text_en: Long-term agreement to supply magnets and build recycling capability

source.label: MP Materials 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In July 2025, the Company entered into a definitive, long-term supply agreement with Apple for the development, manufacture, and supply of magnets from the Independence Facility

companies.name: ゼネラル・モーターズ

relations.text: インディペンデンス工場の基幹顧客として磁石材料を供給
relations.text_en: Foundational customer for magnets and precursor products from the Independence Facility

source.label: MP Materials 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The Magnetics segment began generating revenue from sales of magnetic precursor products to General Motors Company (NYSE: GM) ("GM") in the U.S. in the first quarter of 2025.

relations.text: 日本向けNdPr酸化物・金属の独占販売代理店(2030年末まで)
relations.text_en: Exclusive distributor of its NdPr oxide and metal to Japanese customers through 2030

source.label: MP Materials 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In February 2023, the Company entered into a distributorship agreement (the "Distribution Agreement") with Sumitomo Corporation of Americas ("Sumitomo"), under which Sumitomo serves as the exclusive distributor of the NdPr oxide and NdPr metal produced by the Company to Japanese customers through the end of 2030.

relations.text: かつて精鉱の大半を中国の販売先盛和に売っていたが、2025年7月に中国向け販売を停止
relations.text_en: Historically sold most of its concentrate to Shenghe in China; ceased all China sales in July 2025

source.label: MP Materials 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Historically, the Company sold the vast majority of its rare earth concentrate to a single, principal distributor in China under the terms of the Shenghe Offtake Agreement

relations.text: 国内の競合としてMPマテリアルズを挙げる
relations.text_en: Names MP Materials as its domestic competitor

source.label: USA Rare Earth 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Domestically, we compete with MP Materials Corporation ("MP Materials"), which operates a LREE mine in the U.S. and is pursuing a mine‐to‐magnet strategy

companies.name: エナジー・フューエルズ

relations.text: 中国以外の主な競合としてMPマテリアルズを挙げる
relations.text_en: Names MP Materials among its major competitors outside China

source.label: Energy Fuels 10-Q(2026年9月期)
source.quote: Outside China, major competitors of the Company include MP Materials, which operates rare earth separation and refining facilities at Mountain Pass, California, in the United States

companies.name: アメリカン・リソーシズ

relations.text: 国内の主な競合の一社にMPマテリアルズ
relations.text_en: Names MP Materials among its principal domestic competitors

source.label: American Resources 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Principal domestic competitors are MP Materials, Lithium Americas, Ramaco Resources, Arch Resources, Contura Energy, and Warrior Met Coal.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
